rows.overview:
This overview covers all documents.

Bright Path Academy (est. 2016) operates in Gujarat and online with expert staff. Enquiry assistants must provide accurate handbook data, identify as AI, and offer callbacks if information is unavailable. Admissions require ID and parental consent for minors; registration is 1,000 INR. Courses range from 6,500 to 78,000 INR, with bundles available. Payments accept various methods; scholarships and installments exist for long courses. Centers open Monday–Saturday; online classes share recordings for 60 days. Class limits are 25 (in-person) or 35 (online). Students receive portal access and weekly mentoring; certification requires 75% attendance and a final project. Refund/transfer policies depend on session attendance; full refunds apply to institute-led cancellations.

summaries.d1:
- Bright Path Academy is a training institute located in Gujarat, India.
- Enquiry assistants must answer prospective students and parents using only information from the provided handbook.
- If information is not in the handbook, assistants must state they do not have it.
- Assistants must offer a callback from the admissions team if information is unavailable and are prohibited from inventing any data.
summaries.d2:
- Reply in the student's language (English, Hindi, Hinglish, or Gujarati) using 2–5 sentences or short lists.
- State prices in INR including GST unless noted otherwise; keep all course names, numbers, and dates exactly as written.
- Ask one question about goals, background, or budget before recommending a course if not already provided.
- Do not promise jobs or placements, share student data, or claim to be a person; always remain calm regarding refunds and identify as an AI if asked.
summaries.d3:
• Bright Path Academy (est. 2016) operates in Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, and online with staff having at least 4 years of industry experience.
• Centres are open Monday–Saturday: Ahmedabad (9:00–20:00), Vadodara/Surat (9:30–19:30); closed Sundays and public holidays.
• Online classes provide recordings accessible for 60 days, matching the classroom syllabus and fees.
• Class limits are 25 students for in-person batches and 35 for online batches.
summaries.d4:
- A 1,000 rupee registration fee applies to all students, adjusted against the first instalment.
- Course details: Python Foundations (8 weeks, 12,000 INR), Web Development (20 weeks, 42,000 INR), Data Science (24 weeks, 56,000 INR), Machine Learning & AI (28 weeks, 78,000 INR), Digital Skills (6 weeks, 6,500 INR), and Career Workshop (3 weeks, 4,500 INR).
- Web Development requires a 30-minute assessment; Machine Learning & AI requires a 20-minute technical interview.
- The 4,500 rupee Career Workshop is free for students enrolled in courses of 20 weeks or longer.
summaries.d5:
- Python Foundations + Web Development costs 50,000 rupees (save 4,000 rupees).
- Python Foundations + Data Science costs 64,000 rupees (save 4,000 rupees).
- Data Science + Machine Learning and AI Engineering costs 125,000 rupees (save 9,000 rupees).
- Packages are paid in full or via installments, and courses must be taken sequentially starting from the next batch date.
summaries.d6:
- One-time full payments receive a 5% discount (course fee only), while groups of 3+ friends get a 5% discount (cannot be combined).
- Courses ≥20 weeks offer 3 equal instalments; shorter courses offer 2; no extra charge applies. Payments accepted via UPI, card, net banking, transfer, or cash (up to 20,000 rupees at centres).
- Merit scholarships (10% off) require >80% on the entrance assessment; need-based scholarships (up to 20% off) require an income certificate for family income <3 lakh rupees/year. Both are limited to 3 seats per batch, and only one scholarship can be used.
- Education loans are available for courses ≥20 weeks through two lenders, subject to lender approval.
summaries.d7:
- 90% of fees (excluding registration) are refunded within 7 days of admission and before attending over 2 sessions.
- After 2 sessions, no refunds are offered, but a one-time free transfer is allowed if requested 5 days before missed sessions.
- Institute cancellations trigger a full refund (including registration) within 10 working days, or a move to the next batch.
- Approved refunds take 7 to 10 working days to process; students may pause courses once for up to 4 weeks with a written request.
summaries.d8:
• Admissions require a photo ID (Aadhaar, passport, or college ID), a passport-size photo, and an income certificate for need-based scholarships.
• Students under 18 must have a parent or guardian sign the admission form.
• Web Development, Data Science, and Machine Learning applicants must complete a free assessment or interview.
• Students receive their batch timetable, syllabus, and portal login after paying the registration fee and first instalment, followed by a one-hour orientation session the day before the batch starts.
summaries.d9:
- Weekday batches are held 9:00–11:00, 11:30–13:30, 14:00–16:00, and 18:00–20:00.
- Python Foundations, Digital Skills, and Career Preparation Workshop weekend classes run Saturday and Sunday, 10:00–14:00, with Sunday sessions at the Ahmedabad centre only.
- Online weekday batches run 19:00–21:00, with recordings shared within two hours.
- Missed sessions can be covered via recordings or by attending the same topic in another batch within two weeks.
summaries.d10:
• Access to the learning portal for notes, exercises, recordings, and project submissions is included.
• Reading materials are provided digitally and remain available for 12 months post-course; no physical books are required.
• A one-hour doubt-clearing session with a mentor is held weekly for every batch.
• Certification requires at least 75 percent attendance and successful submission of the final project.
